name: ANAIS-112
notes: external.inspire_experiment is null: INSPIRE was not consulted (its rate budget belongs to the supervised importer).
Placement: hall B of the LSC (arXiv:1812.01472). The Atlas site record for the LSC is a single approximate point for the laboratory, so hall B is named here only.
ANAIS-0, ANAIS-25 and ANAIS-37 are prototype set-ups of the same programme and are recorded as phase intervals, as the collaboration presents them as steps towards ANAIS-112.
ANAIS+ (cryogenic NaI/CsI read out by SiPMs, 'First steps towards the building of a prototype are ongoing' on the ANAIS site) is not recorded: no design report naming a host site was found.

End: the 2026 review says ANAIS-112 'took data until January 2026, by which time it had a sensitivity of ~5 sigma'; the experiment's own page (undated text) says data taking would continue 'until the end of 2025'. Month precision; the exact date of the last data is not published in the sources read.

The joint ANAIS-112 + COSINE-100 annual modulation analysis (Phys. Rev. Lett. 2025, arXiv:2503.19559) is recorded under the COSINE-100 stream (result:cosine-100-anais-112-combined-2025); the lead should add experiment:anais-112 to that record.

physics_goals.quote: ANAIS' goal is to confirm or refute in a model independent way the DAMA/LIBRA positive result
physics_goals.value: Confirm or refute, in a model-independent way and with the same target and technique, the annual modulation reported by DAMA/LIBRA

summary.plain: ANAIS-112 was nine sodium iodide crystals, 112.5 kg in all, in the Canfranc underground laboratory in Spain. Built to check with the same material the yearly dark matter signal reported by DAMA/LIBRA, it took data from August 2017 to early 2026; its published analyses find no such modulation.
summary.technical: Nine 12.5 kg NaI(Tl) modules made by Alpha Spectra in a 3x3 matrix, read by photomultipliers, in hall B of the LSC (2450 m.w.e.); analysis threshold 1 keVee. Dark matter run from 3 August 2017. Annual modulation analyses: 1.5 years (157.55 kg yr) consistent with the null hypothesis; 3 years (313.95 kg yr) incompatible with DAMA/LIBRA at 3.3 (2.6) sigma in [1-6] ([2-6]) keV; 6 years incompatible at 4 sigma.
